title: The government plans to take part of the property
summary: Review the lease and loan provisions on condemnation, engage counsel and an appraiser, and protect the award.

situation.trigger: A government agency notifies the owner of a planned taking of part or all of the property.

outlineSteps: Calendar every date in the notice
Read the notice for what is being taken and when
Read the loan's provisions on condemnation awards
Notify the lender and affected tenants as the documents require
Hire an appraiser to value the taking and the remainder
Assess the effect on access, parking, leases and the loan
Respond to the agency's offer with counsel
Tell investors and record the award and how it is used
